proposals.title: Item 4: Stockholder Proposal — Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board replace each charter and bylaw voting requirement calling for greater than simple majority vote with a majority of votes cast for and against, or simple majority where legally permitted.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote FOR the stockholder proposal regarding a simple majority vote.

proposals.title: Item 5: Stockholder Proposal — Revisit Pay Incentives for GHG Emission Reductions
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the HR and Compensation Committee to revisit executive incentive guidelines and consider eliminating greenhouse gas reduction targets from compensation.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this stockholder proposal.
